title: Settings
description: Configure your editor, workspace, and application preferences.

editor.fontFamily.title: Font Family
editor.fontFamily.description: Controls the font family used in the editor.

editor.fontSize.title: Font Size
editor.fontSize.description: Controls the font size in pixels.

editor.tabSize.title: Tab Size
editor.tabSize.description: The number of spaces a tab is equal to.

editor.wordWrap.title: Word Wrap
editor.wordWrap.description: Controls how lines wrap in the editor.

editor.minimap.enabled.title: Minimap: Enabled
editor.minimap.enabled.description: Shows a miniature overview of your file alongside the editor.

editor.formatOnSave.title: Format On Save
editor.formatOnSave.description: Formats the file when you save. A formatter must be available.

workbench.colorTheme.title: Color Theme
workbench.colorTheme.description: Specifies the preferred color theme for the application.

workbench.startupEditor.title: Startup Editor
workbench.startupEditor.description: Controls which editor is shown when the application starts.

window.zoomLevel.title: Window: Zoom Level
window.zoomLevel.description: Adjusts the zoom level of the application window.

files.autoSave.title: Auto Save
files.autoSave.description: Controls when changes to a file are saved automatically.

files.autoSaveDelay.title: Auto Save Delay
files.autoSaveDelay.description: The delay in milliseconds before a modified file is saved.

files.trimTrailingWhitespace.title: Trim Trailing Whitespace
files.trimTrailingWhitespace.description: Removes whitespace at the end of each line when saving a file.

files.encoding.title: Encoding
files.encoding.description: The default character set used to read and write files.

terminal.integrated.fontSize.title: Integrated: Font Size
terminal.integrated.fontSize.description: Controls the terminal font size in pixels.

terminal.integrated.cursorStyle.title: Integrated: Cursor Style
terminal.integrated.cursorStyle.description: Controls the style of the terminal cursor.

terminal.integrated.copyOnSelection.title: Integrated: Copy On Selection
terminal.integrated.copyOnSelection.description: Copies selected terminal text to the clipboard.
